blocks.x: Revised FY27 Budget: Second & Final Reading
6.1 — Adoption of the Revised FY27 Budget (Second and Final Reading, Roll Call Vote)

This brief, single-item special meeting finalized the budget revision first approved April 29: a $136,295.39 reduction to Articles 3, 4, and 4A, reflecting the School Resource Officer (SRO) program's cost moving entirely into the City's public safety budget (see the April 29 summary for full background). No public comment, no committee discussion.

Approved 6–0 by roll call (second and final reading). This completes the School Committee's side of the FY27 budget process; the combined municipal/school budget proceeds to City Council's own second and final vote the same evening.
